Exact edit action: Use the supplied approved image as the exact identity. Change ONLY state: Intact ROADWORTHY state with the EXACT ORIGINAL wear, ink texture, rust, scratched pigment and patched plates fully retained. No additional collision damage. All original braces, ribs, spikes and markings stay unchanged. Existing stylistic rust and wear remain even in intact state. Keep the complete subject and clear magenta margin; no background scenery. Direct proof review: the word clean stripped too much characteristic Rust and Ink wear from the intact baseline. Flint also lost its rear-bed cross-brace. Preserve the exact original rough ink strokes, worn pigment, rust, bone structural patches and every attachment. Intact means roadworthy, NOT cleaned, repainted, factory-new, smooth plastic or 3D shaded. Keep the full original material texture and structural fittings.
